Container.Name: infinite-mac
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Infinite Mac: classic Mac OS, Mac OS X, NeXT, BeOS and A/UX running in the browser via WebAssembly. System 1 to 7.5.5 work right away; on first start it downloads every other system disk and the CD-ROM catalog into appdata (tens of GB, see the README) and switches over when done. Progress is at /_import. Needs HTTPS (or localhost) for working keyboard and mouse input and the Saved HD disk, so put it behind your reverse proxy. Traefik labels are included: set your hostname in the host rule, and put the container on the same Docker network as Traefik.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: HTTP port. Put HTTPS in front of it.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Downloaded and imported disks, CD-ROMs, the download cache and server state. Can grow to around 100 GB with everything.

Config.Name: Traefik: enable
Config.Description: Route this container through Traefik. Set to false if you don't use Traefik.

Config.Name: Traefik: host rule
Config.Description: Hostname to serve on. Replace mac.example.com with your domain.

Config.Name: Traefik: entrypoint
Config.Description: Your Traefik HTTPS entrypoint name. It must be HTTPS: the emulator needs a secure origin.

Config.Name: Traefik: cert resolver
Config.Description: Name of your Traefik certificate resolver. Remove this label if you use a wildcard or default certificate.

Config.Name: Traefik: service port
Config.Description: Container port Traefik forwards to. Match the Web port's container side.

Config.Name: Systems to download
Config.Description: all, classic (System 1 to 7.5.5 only, no system disk downloads), or comma-separated name filters such as Mac OS 8,Mac OS 9. System 1 to 7.5.5 are always included. CD-ROMs are set separately below.

Config.Name: CD-ROMs
Config.Description: all, or none to skip the CD-ROM and floppy catalog (about 34 GB of downloads).

Config.Name: Keep downloads
Config.Description: true keeps the download cache so re-imports after updates don't download again. false deletes it after each import to save space.
